name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship
description: Scholarships for university/college students above the 80th percentile.

name: PM YASASVI Scholarship
description: Pre-matric and Post-matric scholarships for vibrant students.

name: National Fellowship for SC Students
description: Financial assistance for SC students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Support for minority students at the post-secondary level.

name: Swami Vivekananda Merit Cum Means Scholarship
description: For meritorious economically backward students in West Bengal.

name: Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description: AICTE scheme providing financial assistance for girls pursuing technical education.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
description: Financial independence for women via direct monthly cash transfers.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
description: Improves the life and status of girls by incentivizing schooling and delaying marriage.

name: Mukhyamantri Rajshree Yojana
description: Financial support to parents of girl children from birth to 12th standard.

name: CBSE Udaan Scheme
description: Free online resources and mentoring for girl students for engineering entrance exams.

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Financial assistance to the rural poor for constructing pucca houses.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (PMSYM)
description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Free industry-relevant skill training for Indian youth to secure better jobs.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed minimum pension for citizens, primarily focused on the unorganized sector.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh cover for death due to any reason.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover of ₹2 lakh.
